extDescription.message: Back up your own Instagram saved posts and X bookmarks to your computer, then clear the ones you downloaded.

siteUnsupported.message: Open a logged-in instagram.com or x.com tab, then click the extension icon again.

hintLimit.message: When empty, Clean handles at most $COUNT$ posts per run.

hintXUrl.message: Usually https://x.com/i/bookmarks. Some accounts use https://x.com/i/history.

hintKeepTab.message: Keep this tab open and in front while a job runs. Cleaning moves it from post to post.

warnClean.message: Cleaning cannot be undone. Back up your downloaded files first, even if every file is already downloaded.

chkBackup.message: I understand and I have backed up the files.

confirmReset.message: Forget every download and clean record kept by the extension? Files on disk are not touched, and posts will be downloaded again on the next run.

statusInterrupted.message: Interrupted. Run again to continue where it left off.

logUnverified.message: $COUNT$ posts could not be verified on disk and were left alone

errTabClosed.message: The tab was closed, so the job stopped.

errWrongSite.message: This tab is not on the site the job needs. Open the site and try again.

errLogin.message: You do not seem to be logged in. Log in on the page, then run again.

errRateLimit.message: The site is limiting requests (HTTP 429). Wait a while before running again.

errListRead.message: Could not read the list (HTTP $STATUS$). Check the tab for a verification prompt, then run again.

errThreeInRow.message: Three failures in a row. Stopped to protect your account.

errNoBookmarks.message: No bookmarks were captured. Check the address and that you are logged in.

errBadUrl.message: The bookmarks address must start with https://x.com/.

errNothingToExport.message: No records to export yet. Run Download first.

errStorage.message: The extension storage is full. Run in smaller batches with First N.
